findings.summary: The proposal editor copied one combined sentence into every proposed field (role_title, employer_name and location all received the same wording). Each proposed field now has its own editor prefilled with that field's value, and Use-my-wording submits per-field values with untouched fields sent exactly as proposed. Browser regression captures the submitted confirmed_values. PASS at 5e1a187c64c71fa83e70caa74659e7b00061060f.

The inline correction editor stringified every value, so editing a role title submitted current_role as the string "true" and the server rejected it as invalid. Boolean fields now render as checkboxes and submit real booleans through a shared typed-field helper used by both the inline and proposal editors. Browser regression proves true-kept-true, true-to-false, and false-to-true. PASS at 5e1a187c64c71fa83e70caa74659e7b00061060f.

Activity dated deletions with content timestamps (a September 2 correction displayed as the September 13 deletion date). The service now exposes deleted_at through _present, and both Activity builders date deletions strictly from the lifecycle timestamp, inventing no dated event when it is absent; _delete still leaves content stamps untouched. Unit regressions pin distinct Sept 1/2/13 stamps and the no-invention rule; browser regression pins the API, refreshed timeline, and bootstrap rendering. PASS at 5e1a187c64c71fa83e70caa74659e7b00061060f.
